# Opencage

OpenCage Geocoder provides a simple API for forward and reverse geocoding using open data sources.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/opencage/.

## Actions

- **Forward Geocode Address** (read-only): Convert a human-readable address into geographic coordinates.
- **Geocode to GeoJSON** (read-only): Geocode and return geojson.
- **Geocode with JSONP** (read-only): Perform geocoding and return results in geojsonp format.
- **Geocode XML** (read-only): Perform geocoding and return results in xml format.
- **Reverse Geocode Coordinates** (read-only): Convert coordinates to a human-readable address.
